name: BTC vs SPY Drawdown Comparison with VIX Overlay
description: Research study comparing BTC and SPY historical drawdowns with VIX overlay. Computes running drawdown from peak for both assets, identifies distinct drawdown episodes exceeding -10%, and marks episode troughs. Outputs: (1) Underwater equity chart with trough markers and -10% threshold reference line, (2) VIX level chart in the same dashboard section with regime threshold at 20, (3) Event markers at each episode trough on the candlestick chart, (4) Overall drawdown statistics table (max DD, avg DD, % days in drawdown), (5) Episode-level statistics table (number of >10% episodes, average max DD per episode, average and longest episode duration in days).
source:
# =============================================================================
# BTC VS SPY DRAWDOWN COMPARISON
# =============================================================================
# Question: How do the drawdowns in BTC compare to SPY over the same period?
#
# Chart: xy_lines
#   - X-axis: Date (timestamp index)
#   - Y-axis: Drawdown from peak (percent, negative)
#   - Series: BTC (red), SPY (blue)
#   - Overlay: Reference line at 0%
#
# Table: summary_table
#   - Rows: BTC, SPY
#   - Cols: Max Drawdown, Avg Drawdown, % Days in Drawdown
#
# Dataset:
#   - market_data_source (BTCUSD-Crypto, 1D)
#   - reference_stocks (SPY)
# =============================================================================

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
btc_close = src.c

# BTC drawdown (from running peak)
btc_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(btc_close)
btc_dd = (btc_close - btc_peak) / btc_peak

# SPY via reference
spy_o, spy_h, spy_l, spy_c, spy_v, spy_vw, spy_n = reference_stocks(ticker="SPY")()
spy = ffill(spy_c)
spy_peak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(spy)
spy_dd = (spy - spy_peak) / spy_peak

# =============================================================================
# EPISODE DETECTION: Drawdown episodes exceeding -10%
# =============================================================================
# An episode = a continuous period where drawdown < -0.10
# Trough = local minimum within an episode (dd lower than both neighbors)

# --- BTC episode detection ---
btc_in_deep = btc_dd < -0.10
btc_episode_start = crossunder(btc_dd, -0.10)
# Trough: local minimum while in deep drawdown (1-bar look-ahead, fine for research)
btc_is_trough = btc_in_deep and (btc_dd <= (btc_dd >> 1)) and (btc_dd <= (btc_dd << 1))
btc_trough_dd = where(btc_is_trough, btc_dd)

# BTC streak length (consecutive bars in deep drawdown)
btc_streak = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(btc_in_deep)
# Max episode duration (longest streak)
btc_max_streak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(btc_streak)
# Episode count: cumulative count of episode starts
btc_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(btc_episode_start)
# Total bars in deep drawdown
btc_deep_bars = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(btc_in_deep)
# Average episode duration = total deep bars / episode count
btc_avg_duration = btc_deep_bars / btc_episode_count

# --- SPY episode detection ---
spy_in_deep = spy_dd < -0.10
spy_episode_start = crossunder(spy_dd, -0.10)
spy_is_trough = spy_in_deep and (spy_dd <= (spy_dd >> 1)) and (spy_dd <= (spy_dd << 1))
spy_trough_dd = where(spy_is_trough, spy_dd)

spy_streak = streak_length(direction=StreakDirection.up)(spy_in_deep)
spy_max_streak = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Max)(spy_streak)
spy_episode_count = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(spy_episode_start)
spy_deep_bars = cumulative(agg=AggregationType.Sum)(spy_in_deep)
spy_avg_duration = spy_deep_bars / spy_episode_count

# =============================================================================
# VIX OVERLAY DATA
# =============================================================================
vix_data = indices(ticker='VIX')()
vix_close = ffill(vix_data.c)

# =============================================================================
# DRAWDOWN CHART (original + trough markers)
# =============================================================================
bar_ts = index()

xy_lines(
    title='BTC vs SPY Drawdowns (Troughs Marked)',
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    area=False,
    y_axis_label='Drawdown from Peak (%)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Solid, title='0%'),
        ReferenceLine(value=-0.10, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='-10% Threshold')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC', color=Color.Red),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC Trough', color=Color.Red, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleDownMarker, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='SPY Trough', color=Color.Blue, marker=MarkerSymbol.TriangleDownMarker, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ])
)(bar_ts, btc_dd, spy_dd, btc_trough_dd, spy_trough_dd)

# VIX level chart (same category, secondary context for drawdowns)
xy_lines(
    title='VIX Level',
    category='1. Drawdown Comparison',
    area=True,
    y_axis_label='VIX',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=20, color=Color.Orange, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='VIX 20 Regime Threshold')
    ]),
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='VIX', color=Color.Violet)
    ]),
    order=1
)(bar_ts, vix_close)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: Trough points on candlestick chart
# =============================================================================
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='BTC >10% DD Trough',
        icon=Icon.TrendingDownIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Drawdown Depth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Is Trough', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(btc_dd, btc_is_trough)

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='SPY >10% DD Trough',
        icon=Icon.AlertTriangleIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='Drawdown Depth', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='Is Trough', table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(spy_dd, spy_is_trough)

# =============================================================================
# ORIGINAL SUMMARY TABLE (unchanged)
# =============================================================================
btc_in_dd = btc_dd < 0
spy_in_dd = spy_dd < 0

summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='Drawdown Statistics',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=3,
        row_headers=['BTC', 'SPY'],
        col_headers=['Max Drawdown', 'Avg Drawdown', '% Days in Drawdown'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Min, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1)
        ]
    ),
    category='2. Drawdown Statistics'
)(btc_dd, btc_dd, btc_in_dd, spy_dd, spy_dd, spy_in_dd)

# =============================================================================
# EPISODE SUMMARY TABLE: Per-asset episode-level stats for >10% drawdowns
# =============================================================================
summary_table(
    layout=SummaryTableLayout(
        title='>10% Drawdown Episode Statistics',
        row_size=2,
        col_size=4,
        row_headers=['BTC', 'SPY'],
        col_headers=['# Episodes', 'Avg Max DD / Episode', 'Avg Duration (days)', 'Longest Episode (days)'],
        cells=[
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=0, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=0),
            ColumnSpec(grid_row=1, grid_col=3, grid_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat)
        ]
    ),
    category='3. Episode Statistics'
)(btc_episode_count, btc_trough_dd, btc_avg_duration, btc_max_streak, spy_episode_count, spy_trough_dd, spy_avg_duration, spy_max_streak)
